EmailTemplate.textOnly: REI Nation Investors Outside Property Management Acquisitions For years, you have asked us for our assistance in managing properties not purchased from REI Nation. We are pleased to now extend this offer to you as a current client. If you have properties in any of the 8 cities we are currently operating in, Premier Property Management/ PPMG of Texas is ready to help! The properties can be vacant or occupied. We are currently in the following 8 markets, and ready to serve you: Memphis, TN - St Louis, MO - Dallas, TX - Houston, TX - San Antonio, TX - Oklahoma City, OK - Tulsa, OK - Little Rock, AR If you are interested or know anyone who may need our assistance, please reach out to us and let us know how we can help. For inquiries, please contact: Davartay Miller Email: Davartay@reination.com Office: 901-505-0931
